name: Iris
description: The agent eval standard for MCP. Score every agent output for quality, safety, and cost.

tools.name: log_trace
tools.description: Persist a single agent execution trace (input, output, spans, tool calls, cost, latency, token usage)

tools.name: get_traces
tools.description: Query stored agent-execution traces with filters, pagination, and optional dashboard summary

tools.name: delete_trace
tools.description: Remove a single trace by id; cascades to spans, eval results keep the score history

tools.name: evaluate_output
tools.description: Score agent output against configurable eval rules and return a 0..1 score + per-rule breakdown

tools.name: evaluate_with_llm_judge
tools.description: Score agent output using an LLM as the judge (Anthropic or OpenAI) with a calibrated 0..1 score and rationale

tools.name: verify_citations
tools.description: Extract citations from agent output, fetch the cited sources, and use an LLM judge to check whether each source supports the claim

tools.name: deploy_rule
tools.description: Deploy a new custom evaluation rule that fires on every future evaluate_output call of its eval category

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: Enumerate deployed custom evaluation rules from the local rule store

tools.name: delete_rule
tools.description: Remove a deployed custom evaluation rule; past eval results are preserved

resources.description: Dashboard summary with key metrics and trends
